'''''Launaea arborescens''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref name=TPL_gcc-14764/>

==Taxonomy==
The species was first described by [[Jules Aimé Battandier]] in 1888 as ''Zollikoferia arborescens''. It was transferred to ''[[Launaea]]'' in 1923 by [[Svante Samuel Murbeck]].<ref name=Tropicos_2736115/><ref name=Tropicos_2733915/>

==Distribution==
The species occurs in [[Spain]], the [[Canary Islands]], [[Algeria]], [[Morocco]],<ref name=Tropicos_2733915/> [[Mauritania]] and [[Cape Verde]].<ref name=oromi>Oromí, Martín, Zurita & Cabrera, 2005 : ''[http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/opencms8/export/sites/medioambiente/piac/galerias/descargas/Documentos/Publicaciones/Publicaciones-LPESCaboVerde.pdf Lista preliminar de especies silvestres de Cabo Verde: Hongos, Plantas y Animales Terrestres.]'' Gobierno de Canarias, Consejería de Medio Ambiente y Ordenación Territorial, p. 41</ref>
